system.description:
Trained in the Aldorethi tradition out of the Silver Tower, with its branch in Kyla'naes since the War of Tariel.

  • Elemental Precision: Once per encounter, a spell you cast that deals elemental damage imposes Disadvantage on the target's saving throw against it.
  • Aldorethi Theory: Advantage on Intelligence checks recalling Aldorethi magical theory or history.
